title: Section 2(c) - Definition of Biological Resources
section_title: Section 2(c) - Definition of Biological Resources
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: 'Biological resources' means plants, animals and microorganisms or parts thereof, their genetic material and by-products with actual or potential use or value, but does not include value added products and normally traded commodities.

title: Section 2(f) - Definition of Commercial Utilization
section_title: Section 2(f) - Definition of Commercial Utilization
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: 'Commercial utilization' means end uses of biological resources for commercial utilization such as drugs, industrial enzymes, food flavours, fragrance, cosmetics, emulsifiers, oleoresins, colours, extracts and genes used for improving crops and livestock.

title: Section 3 - Regulation of Access to Biological Diversity by Foreign Entities
section_title: Section 3 - Regulation of Access to Biological Diversity by Foreign Entities
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: No person who is not a citizen of India, or a citizen of India who is an NRI, or a body corporate, association or organization incorporated outside India or having non-Indian participation in share capital or management shall access biological resources or traditional knowledge for research or commercial utilization without prior approval of NBA.

title: Section 4 - Transfer of Results of Research
section_title: Section 4 - Transfer of Results of Research
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: No person shall, without the prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority, transfer the results of any research relating to any biological resources occurring in, or obtained from, India to any person who is not a citizen of India or is a body corporate not registered in India.

title: Section 6 - Prior Approval of NBA for Applying for IPR
section_title: Section 6 - Prior Approval of NBA for Applying for IPR
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Under Section 6 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (amended 2023), no person shall apply for any intellectual property right, by whatever name called, in or outside India for any invention based on any research or information on a biological resource obtained from India without obtaining the prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA). Approval must be obtained before the grant of the patent or right. For foreigners, NRIs, and foreign-controlled entities, Section 3 requires prior NBA approval even before accessing biological resources.

title: Section 7 - Prior Intimation to State Biodiversity Board (SBB) by Indian Citizens
section_title: Section 7 - Prior Intimation to State Biodiversity Board (SBB) by Indian Citizens
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Section 7 of the Biological Diversity Act mandates that no person who is a citizen of India or a body corporate, association or organization registered in India shall obtain any biological resource for commercial utilization or bio-survey and bio-utilization for commercial utilization except after giving prior intimation to the State Biodiversity Board (SBB) concerned. The 2023 amendment exempts registered AYUSH practitioners and cultivated medicinal plants growers from Section 7 intimation, but commercial formulation manufacturing entities remain subject to intimation and fair and equitable benefit sharing regulations.

title: Section 19 - Approval by National Biodiversity Authority for Access
section_title: Section 19 - Approval by National Biodiversity Authority for Access
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Any person referred to in subsection (2) of section 3 who intends to obtain any biological resource occurring in India or associated knowledge for research or for commercial utilization shall make an application to the National Biodiversity Authority in Form I.

title: Section 20 - Transfer of Biological Resource or Knowledge
section_title: Section 20 - Transfer of Biological Resource or Knowledge
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: No person who has been granted approval under section 19 shall transfer any biological resource or knowledge associated thereto which is the subject matter of the approval to any other person except with the prior approval of the National Biodiversity Authority in Form IV.

title: Section 21 - Determination of Equitable Benefit Sharing
section_title: Section 21 - Determination of Equitable Benefit Sharing
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Section 21 empowers the National Biodiversity Authority to determine fair and equitable benefit sharing arising out of the use of accessed biological resources, their by-products, innovations, and commercialization. Benefit sharing options include direct monetary sharing (0.1% to 0.5% of ex-factory sale price), joint ownership of IPR, technology transfer, or community biodiversity management funds.

title: Section 23 - Functions of State Biodiversity Boards
section_title: Section 23 - Functions of State Biodiversity Boards
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: The functions of the State Biodiversity Board shall be to advise the State Government on matters relating to the conservation of biodiversity, sustainable use of its components and equitable sharing of the benefits arising out of the utilization of biological resources.

title: Section 40 - Exemption for Normally Traded Commodities (NTC)
section_title: Section 40 - Exemption for Normally Traded Commodities (NTC)
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Under Section 40 of the Biological Diversity Act, the Central Government may, in consultation with the National Biodiversity Authority, by notification in the Official Gazette, exempt certain biological resources normally traded as commodities (NTC List) from the provisions of this Act when traded strictly as agricultural commodities for consumption. However, if such items are accessed for research, bio-survey, or intellectual property filing, the Section 40 exemption does not apply.

title: Section 41 - Constitution of Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs) and Peoples Biodiversity Registers (PBR)
section_title: Section 41 - Constitution of Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs) and Peoples Biodiversity Registers (PBR)
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Every local body shall constitute a Biodiversity Management Committee within its area for the purpose of promoting conservation, sustainable use and documentation of biological diversity including preservation of habitats, conservation of land races, folk varieties and cultivars, domesticated stocks and breeds of animals and microorganisms and chronicling of knowledge relating to biological diversity (PBR).

title: Section 55 - Penalties for Contravention
section_title: Section 55 - Penalties for Contravention
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Whoever contravenes or attempts to contravene or abets the contravention of the provisions of section 3 or section 4 or section 6 shall be liable to civil penalties under the 2023 Amendment Act through adjudication by designated inquiry officers.

title: Section 8 of The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (amended 2023)
section_title: Section 8 of The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (amended 2023)
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
content: Statutory provision under Section 8 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002 & 2023 Amendment governing biodiversity governance, NBA/SBB jurisdictions, local benefit funds, and statutory compliance.
